summary: Erdős problem #1219 (erdosproblems.com/1219; Erdős–Hajnal 1971, Problem 3, asked by Erdős, Hajnal and Rado): let (n_k) be an increasing sequence of integers such that 2^{ℵ_{n_k}} is strictly increasing and 2^{ℵ_{n_0}} > ℵ_ω; is it true that Σ_k 2^{ℵ_{n_k}} → (ℵ_ω)²?
